01 · The first 50

The first fifty,
as the widget deals them

HSK 3 adds 298 new words and takes the cumulative syllabus to about 600. This is the level where real conversations begin: work, study, travel and opinions in plain sentences. Every entry shows the hanzi, pinyin with tone marks and an English meaning.

In Lock&Learn Chinese this list is the HSK 3 pack: a word waits in hanzi with its pinyin; one tap reveals the meaning and a real sentence. HSK 3 opens with a free preview and another word unlocks daily; Lock&Learn+ opens every pack at once.

Type to filter by hanzi, pinyin or meaning. Flashcards hides the meaning until you tap a row; Shuffle deals the list in a new order.

02 · Sample sentences

25 words,
each in a sentence

Every word in Lock&Learn Chinese comes with a real example sentence, its reading and a translation, revealed on the tap. Here are 25 of the words above, in a sentence.

选择

xuǎnzé

to choose; choice

你必须在今天做出选择。

Nǐ bìxū zài jīntiān zuòchū xuǎnzé.

You must make a choice today.

跟

gēn

with or following

我想跟你一起去公园玩。

Wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ yìqǐ qù gōngyuán wán.

I want to go to the park with you.

阿姨

āyí

aunt or polite address

我有空就去帮邻居王阿姨打扫卫生。

Wǒ yǒu kòng jiù qù bāng línjū Wáng āyí dǎsǎo wèishēng.

I help my neighbor Aunt Wang with cleaning whenever I am free.

游戏

yóu xì

game

我喜欢和朋友一起玩电脑游戏。

Wǒ xǐhuān hé péngyǒu yīqǐ wán diànnǎo yóuxì.

I like playing computer games with my friends.

健康

jiànkāng

healthy; health

为了身体健康，我每天都跑步。

Wèile shēntǐ jiànkāng, wǒ měitiān dōu pǎobù.

I run every day for the sake of my health.

秋

qiū

autumn

秋天的天气非常凉快。

Qiūtiān de tiānqì fēicháng liángkuài.

The weather in autumn is very cool.

除了

chúle

except or besides

除了他以外，大家都去公园了。

Chúle tā yǐwài, dàjiā dōu qù gōngyuán le.

Except for him, everyone went to the park.

周末

zhōumò

weekend

这个周末我们一起去公园玩儿。

Zhè ge zhōumò wǒmen yìqǐ qù gōngyuán wánr.

We are going to play at the park together this weekend.

结束

jiéshù

to finish or end

会议在下午五点结束。

Huìyì zài xiàwǔ wǔ diǎn jiéshù.

The meeting ends at five in the afternoon.

一会儿

yīhuìr

a little while

请等我一会儿，我马上就好。

Qǐng děng wǒ yīhuìr, wǒ mǎshàng jiù hâo.

Please wait for me a little while, I will be ready soon.

眼镜

yǎnjìng

pair of eyeglasses

我看不清楚，必须戴眼镜。

Wǒ kàn bù qīngchu, bìxū dài yǎnjìng.

I cannot see clearly and must wear my eyeglasses.

为了

wèile

in order to

为了身体健康，我每天跑步。

Wèile shēntǐ jiànkāng, wǒ měitiān pǎobù.

I run every day in order to stay healthy.

东

Dōng

east

我家住在学校的东边。

Wǒ jiā zhù zài xuéxiào de dōngbiān.

My house is on the east side of the school.

宾馆

bīnguǎn

hotel

这家宾馆就在火车站旁边。

Zhè jiā bīnguǎn jiù zài huǒchēzhàn pángbiān.

This hotel is right next to the train station.

刻

kè

quarter hour

Xiànzài shì shí diǎn sān kè.

我们学校下个星期要举行一次篮球比赛。

低

dī

low

这个房间的房租很低。

Zhège fángjiān de fángzū hěn dī.

关系

guānxi

relationship or connection

他们之间的关系非常好。

Tāmen zhī jiān de guānxi fēicháng hǎo.

The relationship between them is very good.

马上

mǎshàng

at once

你等我一下，我马上就来。

Nǐ děng wǒ yīxià, wǒ mǎshàng jiù lái.

脚

jiǎo

human foot

我的脚有点疼，不能去跑步了。

Wǒ de jiǎo yǒudiǎn téng, bùnéng qù pǎobù le.

城市

chéngshì

city or town

Wǒ zài zhè zuò chéngshì zhùle wǔ nián.

I have lived in this city for five years.

参加

cānjiā

participate or join

明天下午你会参加这次活动吗？

Míngtiān xiàwǔ nǐ huì cānjiā zhè cì huódòng ma?

Will you participate in this activity tomorrow afternoon?

会议

huìyì

meeting or conference

我们早上有一个会议。

Wǒmen zǎoshang yǒu yīgè huìyì.

We have a meeting this morning.

树

shù

a tree

花园里有很多大树。

Huāyuán lǐ yǒu hěn duō dà shù.

There are many large trees in the garden.

04 · Questions

Asked and
answered

How many words are in the HSK 3 vocabulary list?

298. The six-level HSK syllabus adds about 150, 150, 300, 600, 1,300 and 2,500 new words per level, about 5,000 in all; this page lists the words that are new at HSK 3, not the cumulative total.

Why does this page show 50 of the 298 words?

The complete HSK 3 list is the HSK 3 pack in Lock&Learn Chinese. This page shows the first 50 words the widget deals, enough to judge the level and to try the flashcards. In the app the pack opens with a free preview, another word unlocks daily, and Lock&Learn+ opens all 298 at once.

Is this the official HSK HSK 3 word list?

It follows the official six-level HSK syllabus (HSK 2.0), the list the HSK 1 to 6 exams are still administered on. The HSK 3.0 standard published in 2021 reorganises vocabulary into nine bands and is not what this page shows.

How do I study the HSK 3 list on my iPhone Lock Screen?

Install Lock&Learn Chinese, then touch and hold your Lock Screen, tap Customize, tap the widget area and choose Lock&Learn Chinese. The HSK 3 pack puts these words on the widget one at a time: you recall the meaning, one tap reveals it with a real sentence. HSK 3 opens with a free preview and another word unlocks daily; Lock&Learn+ opens every pack at once.

Can I download the HSK 3 vocabulary list as a PDF?

Use your browser's Print or Save as PDF for the words on this page; the page has a print layout that keeps only the heading and the table. The complete list lives in the app.

Is Lock&Learn Chinese free?

Yes. The app is free on iOS: HSK 1 is free, every other pack opens with a free preview, and another word unlocks daily. Lock&Learn+ is an optional upgrade that opens every pack at once, offered as a yearly plan or a one-time lifetime purchase.
